The '''Drilbia system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of beverage known as [[Drilbian wine]].<ref name="Campaign Pack">''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Drilbian wine]]|system=Drilbia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The "Drilb [[Star system/Legends|system]],"<ref name="Twinkle" /> in reference to the Drilbian [[Wine/Legends|wine]] beverage,<ref name="Campaign Pack" /> was first mentioned in "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[roleplaying game]] source article written by [[Glen Allison]] as a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in [[Voyages SF 13|''Voyages SF'' 13]]. The article placed the [[Star/Legends|star]] system in the [[Dartibek sector]]<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> and is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], named the system "Drilbia" and placed it in grid square M-17.<ref name="TEA" />
